justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Consistent finding: no patient outcome difference between DPT and MPT graduates.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Post-professional DPT or OTD programs typically 18-36 months; significant tuition cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Credential equivalency; no specific caseload benefit over clinical master's training.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No billing difference between DPT and MPT graduates in most payer contracts; credential equivalency only.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: DPT now considered standard entry-level credential; widely required by employers even without outcome advantage.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients do not distinguish degree level in satisfaction surveys.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: 'Doctor' title supports direct-access cash-pay branding, but doesn't itself drive willingness to pay.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Modest pricing lift from doctoral title in some markets; largely commoditized since DPT is now entry-level.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Now the entry-level standard for PT, so it differentiates only against legacy MPTs.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Doctoral framing supports brand authority and direct-access positioning for a clinic.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers respond to 'doctor' framing in marketing, though they often conflate with MD.
justifications.business.efficiency: 3+ years and $100K+; extremely inefficient if the only goal is business leverage.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Terminal clinical doctorate is the minimum credential for most tenure-track clinical faculty lines; OTD increasingly preferred for OT faculty.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Doctoral capstones produce some scholarship, but DPT/OTD are clinical, not research, doctorates.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Required to teach in most CAPTE/ACOTE programs and signals clinical depth.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Curricula vary widely; not itself a marker of evidence-based depth.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Explicitly required or strongly preferred in nearly all PT/OT faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Time and cost are high, but it is a prerequisite, not optional; efficiency framing barely applies.
